result.title: MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery
result.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 33rd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Cycle 1
result.summary: Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. RIMA retrieves candidate records, performs evidence-grounded POI matching and attribute-level reasoning, and selectively acquires complementary visual, geospatial, or external-source evidence when necessary. In human-reviewed full-task evaluation, MAPS outperforms the strongest baseline by 21.8\%. MAPS has also been deployed in Kuaishou's large-scale POI production pipeline, reducing average processing time by 76.9\% relative to manual annotation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical value of MAPS for scalable POI maintenance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究从众包街景图像自动生产 POI 数据的问题，提出 MAPS 两级框架：SPICE 用轻量 VLM 重建并过滤文本、按 POI 分组并判断语义与完整性，RIMA 检索候选记录、做证据支撑的匹配与属性级推理并在必要时补充视觉、地理或外部证据，在人工复核评测中超过最强基线 21.8% 并已上线。
AI.relevance_reason: RIMA 的「按需获取互补证据」与 SPICE 的完整性判定，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供可核查线索；但论文是数据库维护应用，不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系需人工判断。
